xlsx.mini.min.js  SheetJS CE 0.18.5 (Apache-2.0)        https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/xlsx/0.18.5/xlsx.mini.min.js
fonts/            Newsreader, IBM Plex Mono, Source Sans 3 (SIL Open Font License), from Google Fonts
To update: download the new version, replace the file, update this list, run build_app_data.py.
(xlsx.mini.min.js: one raw ESC byte inside a string literal written as \u001b; behaviour unchanged)
